verdict.rationale: The docs say every money movement creates a Transaction object, a ledger entry that can be retrieved through the API and webhook events to reconcile against internal systems. That gives programmatic, structured access to the core financial data, plus a route to move funds out via outbound payments. It falls well short of a documented 'export everything and leave' capability. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account data export, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/OFX), account closure or offboarding guidance, coverage of non-transaction data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export.
